plain: A French Protestant of the 1500s and 1600s.

webster.text: A name formerly given to a protestant in France.

example.quote: and fifty years hence, the French may renew the persecution of the Huguenots, whilst the Spaniards in their turn may become indifferent to their forms of religion.
example.cite: An Old Whig V, Philadelphia Independent Gazetteer, Nov. 1, 1787
